title: Review Queue Avalanche
one_liner: Watch human code reviewers drown as AI output speeds up, until the loop closes by default.
speaker: Emad Mostaque
context: Demis said today's RSI keeps humans reviewing code while engineers get several times more productive. Emad replied that no human can review thousands of tokens per second from a hundred thousand model instances.
demo: Sliders set the number of human reviewers, model instances and tokens per second. An animated queue of pull requests piles up in front of the reviewers. A gauge shows the share of AI changes that actually get human review, and when it falls below a threshold the page flips to 'effectively closed loop'.
data_plan: Episode figures preloaded as presets (3–5x productivity, 10,000 tokens per second, 100,000 instances). Human review speed is a user-adjustable assumption, clearly labelled.
risks: Review-speed assumptions are made up and must be labelled as such. This is an illustration, not a forecast.
